parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small flush button made of plastic, located on the top or side of the toilet tank.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism to release water from the tank into the bowl.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Lid (Tank Cover)
parts.Basic_description: A ceramic lid that covers the top of the toilet tank.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the internal flushing components and prevents debris from entering the tank.
parts.Movement_description: It is removable but typically remains stationary during normal use.

parts.name: Lid (Seat Cover)
parts.Basic_description: A plastic lid attached to the toilet seat, used to cover the bowl.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a hygienic cover and can be closed when the toilet is not in use.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates upward and downward around a hinge at the back of the seat.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main ceramic body of the toilet, including the bowl and tank structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the user, holds water, and channels waste into the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structure anchored to the floor.
